question: In how many states was the first round of Mission Indradhanush (IMI) 4.0 organised by the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in February 2022, with an aim to increase full immunisation coverage?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first round of** Mission Indradhanush (IMI) 4.0** was organised by the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in **11 states** in February 2022.
 
• The aim of the initiative was to increase the** full immunisation** coverage across these states.
 
• Mission Indradhanush aims to vaccinate all unvaccinated and partially vaccinated children and pregnant women by 2022 against vaccine-preventable diseases.
 
• The campaign is conducted in rounds, with each round focusing on identified high-risk areas.
 
• IMI 4.0 is a strategic endeavor to ensure that the **benefits of vaccination reach every child and pregnant woman** in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mission Indradhanush was first launched in December 2014 to achieve full immunisation coverage for all children and pregnant women at a rapid pace.
 
• The mission focuses on districts and urban areas with low immunisation coverage to ensure that no child is left out.
 
• It includes vaccines for diseases such as diphtheria, whooping cough, tetanus, polio, tuberculosis, measles, and hepatitis B, among others.
 
• Special attention is given to marginalized and under-served populations, including those living in remote and inaccessible areas.
 
• The initiative has been praised for its contribution to reducing child mortality and improving maternal health in India.
